children: Capital Southwest entered into a Fourth Amended and Restated Senior Secured Revolving Credit Agreement to increase liquidity and extend maturities. The facility boosts commitments to $595 million, adds an uncommitted accordion up to $1 billion, extends the revolving period to 2030 with final maturity in 2031, and lowers unused fees to 0.50%-0.75% per year. The agreement, led by ING Capital as administrative agent with Texas Capital Bank as documentation agent and other lenders participating, is expected to enhance flexibility for ongoing investments and corporate needs.
: Fourth Amended and Restated senior secured revolving credit facility
: ING Capital, Texas Capital Bank, and other lenders
: Revolving through Sep 02 2030; final maturity Sep 02 2031
: Enhance liquidity, extend maturities, and increase borrowing capacity
